reviewed_by: Codex (AI-assisted analyst; original official documents checked)
catalog_note: The requested source_catalog.template.json was not present in the checked-out repository. This catalog is a separate file using the requested provenance fields; no template or pipeline code was changed.

sources.source_class: issuer annual report; statutory integrated annual report
sources.verification_method: Official NTPC-hosted original PDF checked against its Directors' Report and capacity tables; publisher listing and exchange filing date checked.

claims.metric_label: Renewable Energy Projects, owned by your Company
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Limited parent-owned projects (standalone project scope)
claims.passage: Under ‘I Owned by your Company’, row ‘c) Renewable Energy Projects’ = 725 MW.
claims.caveat: This exact table value is not a standalone claim in the reviewed-inputs list; it is a table cross-check. It differs from the 709 MW residual formed by subtracting 13,791 MW from rounded 14,500 MW.

claims.metric_label: Total (I), projects owned by your Company
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Limited parent-owned projects (standalone project scope)
claims.passage: Owned project components are coal 13,840 MW, hydro 811 MW, renewable 725 MW; ‘Total (I)’ = 15,376 MW.
claims.caveat: Exact table total; components sum exactly.

claims.metric_label: total commercial capacity / cumulative installed capacity
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group, consolidated; not NTPC Limited standalone
claims.passage: As on 31 March 2025, the total commercial capacity stood at 79,930 MW on a consolidated basis and 59,413 MW on a standalone basis. Section 9 also says NTPC Group's cumulative installed capacity was 79,930 MW.
claims.caveat: The reviewed input says commissioned commercial capacity, which is supported; the annual report uses both commercial and installed labels for the same group figure. This should not be relabelled as renewable capacity.

claims.exact_value: 14,516 MW in the component breakdown; 14.5 GW in narrative
claims.metric_label: Renewable projects under implementation / ongoing projects
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group: NTPC-owned and JV/subsidiary projects combined
claims.page: 91 (section 9.1, Capacity Expansion Program, narrative and Ongoing Projects table); Organic Growth discussion prints rounded 14.5 GW on printed page 220 (reviewed claim chunk locator says page 112)
claims.passage: Narrative: ‘14,516 MW of Renewable projects (Including 13,791 MW being undertaken by joint venture and subsidiary company).’ Table: ‘c) Renewable Energy Projects’ under ‘I Owned by your Company’ = 725 MW; ‘c) Renewable Projects’ under ‘II Projects under JVs & Subsidiaries’ = 13,791 MW.
claims.caveat: Reviewed input value 14.5 GW is a one-decimal rounded narrative number (= 14,500 MW); exact table/narrative breakdown is 14,516 MW. The 16 MW difference is material for precise ratios and must not be treated as exact equality. ‘Under implementation’ is the report's wording; the table heading calls these ongoing projects.

claims.metric_label: Total On-Going Projects as on 31 March 2025 (I)+(II)
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group: owned projects plus JV/subsidiary projects
claims.passage: ‘Total (I)’ parent-owned projects = 15,376 MW; ‘Total (II)’ projects under JVs & Subsidiaries = 18,295 MW; ‘Total On-Going Projects as on 31 March 2025 (I)+(II)’ = 33,671 MW.
claims.caveat: The source has separate rows for NTPC-owned and JV/subsidiary projects. 33,671 MW is their aggregate, not a standalone NTPC-only pipeline. The component totals sum exactly.

claims.entity_scope: JV/subsidiary component of NTPC Group ongoing projects
claims.passage: Under ‘II Projects under JVs & Subsidiaries’: coal 3,060 MW; hydro 1,444 MW; renewable 13,791 MW; ‘Total (II)’ = 18,295 MW.
claims.caveat: This is all technology capacity (coal, hydro and renewable), not a renewable-only denominator. Its components sum exactly.

claims.entity_scope: JV/subsidiary component of NTPC Group ongoing projects
claims.passage: Table row ‘c) Renewable Projects’ within ‘II Projects under JVs & Subsidiaries’ = 13,791 MW. Narrative says 14,516 MW total renewable projects, including 13,791 MW undertaken by JV and subsidiary companies.
claims.caveat: The extracted claim is unresolved in its source chunk, but the original table resolves the amount and scope. It is a JV/subsidiary subset of the 14,516 MW exact renewable total, rather than an amount to compare against rounded 14.5 GW as if the latter were exact. The annual report does not split JV versus subsidiary amounts individually.

claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group / company-wide RE capacity statement; report does not specify standalone vs consolidated in this sentence
claims.page: 220, Organic Growth discussion (reviewed claim chunk locator says page 112)
claims.passage: ‘As on 31 March 2025, Your Company has a cumulative commissioned RE capacity of 6.8 GW.’
claims.caveat: The sentence uses ‘Your Company’ without stating consolidated/group basis. The annual report separately discusses NTPC and JV/subsidiary renewable projects, and the August 2025 presentation says present RE capacity is 8 GW. The 6.8 GW value therefore cannot be confirmed as a group metric; entity-scope mismatch remains unresolved.

sources.source_class: issuer quarterly and full-year results investor call transcript
sources.document_title: Transcript of Conference Call on Audited Financial Results for FY 2024-25
derived_from: NTPC FY 2024-25 financial and operating results; same issuer disclosure family

claims.exact_value: 33.7 GW total; 16.9 GW coal; 2.2 GW hydro; 14.6 GW renewable
claims.as_of_date: 2025-05-24 (current status stated during results call; not explicitly 2025-03-31)
claims.passage: ‘Currently, 33.7 GW of capacity is under construction, comprising 16.9 GW of coal, 2.2 GW of hydro, and 14.6 GW of renewable energy projects.’
claims.caveat: Rounded to 0.1 GW, said as ‘currently’ on 24 May 2025 rather than explicitly as at 31 March. It is same-issuer repetition, not an independent corroborating source, and does not split parent vs JV/subsidiary.

claims.exact_value: 17,277 MW contracted and awarded; 5,902 MW commercial capacity
claims.metric_label: NGEL contracted/awarded capacity and commercial capacity
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Green Energy Limited (subsidiary), not full NTPC Group
claims.passage: NGEL total commercial capacity 5,902 MW as of March 31, 2025; its total contracted and awarded capacity stands at 17,277 MW as at 31 March 2025.
claims.caveat: ‘Contracted and awarded’ is a different project stage/metric from ‘under implementation’; not directly comparable to the pipeline values under review.

sources.publisher: NTPC Limited; filing submitted to stock exchanges
sources.document_title: Submission of Integrated Annual Report for Financial Year 2024-25
sources.note: The exchange filing and issuer-hosted annual report are one disclosure lineage. They must not be counted as independent corroboration. NTPC's filing locator lists the annual report submission on 2025-08-07.

sources.publisher: NTPC Limited; submitted to NSE and BSE
sources.document_title: Investor Presentation to 21st Annual Analysts and Institutional Investors Meet
sources.reporting_period: Capacity breakdown as on 2025-06-30; selected installed-capacity chart as on 2025-03-31
derived_from: NTPC FY 2024-25 operating data; NTPC issuer disclosure family

claims.exact_value: 30,853 MW construction; 82,646 MW operation; 113,499 MW portfolio
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group, with separate subsidiary/JV rows
claims.passage: Slide heading ‘Overview - Operation and Under Construction Capacity (in MW)’; source ‘as on June 30, 2025’; NTPC Group operation 82,646 MW, construction 30,853 MW, portfolio 113,499 MW.
claims.caveat: Different date and total than March 31 annual report (33,671 MW ongoing). Do not call this a contradiction; the later-date/current construction metric can change. Slide 6 also provides technology/entity subrows, but it does not reproduce the March 31 JV project table.

claims.exact_value: 60 GW+ RE capacity target by 2032; visible RE pipeline 24 GW+
claims.entity_scope: NTPC Group / strategy scope; detailed pipeline basis not defined on slide
claims.passage: ‘Plan to have 60 GW+ RE Capacity by 2032’ and ‘Visible RE pipeline of 24 GW+.’
claims.caveat: ‘Visible RE pipeline’ is broader and not labelled under implementation, and it is later than the reviewed as-of date. It cannot substitute for the 14,516 MW as-of-March 31 under-implementation amount.

sources.publisher: Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, Government of India
sources.source_class: government regulator report locator; independent publisher
sources.document_title: Quarterly Report on Under-construction Renewable Energy Projects, March 2025
sources.note: CEA's official RPM report listing identifies this report and date, making it a genuinely independent official source family. The CEA page redirected to its login gate during this review, and the report's project-level table could not be inspected; therefore no CEA number is asserted as corroboration of NTPC's 14,516/13,791/33,671 MW figures. CEA project coverage and NTPC's ownership/consolidation boundary may also differ.

sources.publisher: Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, Government of India
sources.source_class: government installed capacity statistical report locator
sources.note: Independent source family relevant to operating installed capacity, but the public page currently lists newer months and this review did not retrieve a March 2025 company-wise table. It cannot corroborate 79,930 MW on the evidence inspected here and does not measure under-implementation pipeline.

input_verification_summary.reviewed_value: 709 MW in the saved calculation; annual report table: 725 MW
input_verification_summary.reason: The calculation's 709 MW is derived from rounded 14,500 MW minus 13,791 MW; exact annual report component table gives 725 MW (=14,516−13,791).
The exact Total (I) row for owned projects in the annual report.
Printed renewable row under the JV/subsidiary table heading and stated as a subset of total renewable projects.
Printed Total (II) for JV/subsidiary projects; all technologies.

independence_assessment: The annual report, NTPC exchange filing, and NTPC results transcript belong to one issuer disclosure lineage and are not independent sources. CEA is an independent government source, but report data were inaccessible for claim-level checking in this review; no independent corroboration is claimed.
limitations: No source_catalog.template.json existed in the checked-out repository.

The original official annual report PDF was inspected through its official publisher-hosted PDF text and tables. The 32.6 MB PDF could not be downloaded into a pinned local snapshot in this environment, so no hash is supplied.

The reviewed-inputs file's own reviewer note says its claims were chosen from extracted text and the original PDF was unavailable at that time; this catalog records the subsequent direct document review.
No pipeline code or evidence verification statuses were changed.
